_comment: Pinned Apify actor(s) for platform trend reads, per CLAUDE.md §1d, so the Routine doesn't pick a different actor each day.

tiktok_trends_actor.title: TikTok Trends
tiktok_trends_actor.notes: Trending-hashtags mode supports countryCode=SG directly (TikTok Creative Center rankings: rank, posts, video views, trend direction). Top-videos mode does not support SG. Cap: maxItems 20, one run per day.

instagram_trends_actor.title: Instagram Trending Scraper
instagram_trends_actor.notes: Explore feed. `country` only sets Accept-Language, it does not geolocate: on 2026-09-23 all 20 posts were US content (Hispanic Heritage Month, NFL), published_at empty on every row. Label the card as the Explore feed with SG locale, never as 'trending in SG', unless posts show real Singapore signals. ~US$0.09 and ~3 min per run of 20.
